text:
The immediate-after rules lock Hana–Gus–Dev into three consecutive slots and Finn–Ben into two. Elif must sit two slots after Dev (the slot two before Dev is Hana), and Ben must sit two slots after Elif, so the only block that fits in 1–9 is:

Hana, Gus, Dev, (open), Elif, Finn, Ben

Hana before Ann before Elif fills that open slot with Ann. Cara must then be two slots after Finn, which forces Hana into slot 2, Ivo into the only remaining slot before Finn, and Cara into slot 9. That placement also keeps Ann and Ivo four slots apart.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ivo","2":"Hana","3":"Gus","4":"Dev","5":"Ann","6":"Elif","7":"Finn","8":"Ben","9":"Cara"}
